senses.gloss:
--the capital of इक्ष्वाकुस्. The children of अयोध्या were cast into the सरयू by असमञ्- jasa and then restored to life by his yogic power.
1: भा. IX. 8. १७-19.
Chief buildings were प्रासाद, गोपुर, सभा, चैत्य and देवगृह;
2: Ib. IX. ११. २५-34; Br. III. ६३. २१;
one of the holy cities.
3: Br. IV. ४०. ९१.
City of Rama and Sagara;
4: Br. III. ३७. ३३; ४७. ७५; ४८. 1; ४९. १० and ५८; ५३. 5.
also known as शाकेत.
5: Br. III. ५४. ५४.
Capital of मध्यदेश of King दिवाकर, famous for रामतीर्थम्;
6: M. १९१. ९३; २७१. 5. Vi. IV. 4. ९७; वा. ९९. २८२.
in the nose por- tion of the personified Veda.
7: वा. ८८. २०, ९४; १०४. ८१: १११. ६८.
--a तीर्थम् on the नर्मदा: rids a man of rebirth. M. १९१. ६१.

(I)--a son of Danu;
1: भा. VI. 6. ३०; Br. III. 6. 5; M. 6. १७; Vi. I. २१. 4.
followed वृत्र in his war with Indra;
2: भा. VI. १०. १९.
took part in the देवासुर war between Bali and Indra.
3: Ib. VIII. १०. १९.
[page१-096+ २५]
(II)--Mt. a hill with medicinal herbs. M. १६३. ७१.
(II)--the wife of Vighna. Br. III. ५९. १३; वा. ८४. १३.
